action: Respond to Sarah Kim's outreach directly — call or text her today. She is reaching out to me for a reason, and I want to understand it before I project anything onto it. Set up a short meeting, coffee or a walk-through of the shop, wherever she is comfortable. My goal is to listen: Is she looking to reskill? Thinking about career change? Looking for part-time work that keeps her in vehicles but hedges her mechanic income? Whatever her situation, I want to understand it and then ask one clear question: would she be willing to come in as a guest instructor for one session to show students what real diagnostic work looks like on a hybrid or EV system? Even a single appearance from a working mechanic carries more credibility with students — and with a school board — than any curriculum document. If the relationship is there, I make the ask. If not, I build toward it.
